citation: Hao Y, Hao S, Andersen-Nissen E, et al. Integrated analysis of multimodal single-cell data. *Cell* 2021.
data: GEO GSE164378; also distributed through SeuratData / Azimuth
key_finding: NKG7 is highest in NK cells and effector CD8 and cytotoxic CD4 T cells and correlates with granzymes, perforin, GNLY and CTSW. A virtual NKG7 knock-out (scTenifoldKnk, a network-based prediction from co-expression, not an experiment) is used to ask which genes are most tied to NKG7; CD226 marks cytotoxic CD4 T cells.

citation: The Tabula Muris Consortium. Single-cell transcriptomics of 20 mouse organs creates a Tabula Muris. *Nature* 2018.
key_finding: Nkg7 and cytotoxic genes are found in NK and T cells across mouse tissues; this analysis mainly provides an integrated immune baseline and batch/composition checks.

citation: The Tabula Sapiens Consortium. The Tabula Sapiens: a multiple-organ, single-cell transcriptomic atlas of humans. *Science* 2022.
key_finding: NKG7 and the cytotoxic programme are concentrated in NK and CD8 T cells across human tissues, with tissue-specific granzyme profiles.
